task: EDIT ME: describe the documentation change the loop should make.
rules: Do not delete a fact to make a sentence shorter. Numbers, backticked identifiers and URLs from the previous revision must survive the rewrite.
Do not chop sentences to beat a length gate. The mean-sentence-floor and variance floor exist to catch that and will fail the run.

sensors.name: prose
sensors.hint: Cut marketing adjectives, hedges and filler transitions rather than shortening sentences. The score counts only those categories; passive voice and paragraph length are reported but never gated.
sensors.canary:
printf '# Canary

Our robust and seamless solution effortlessly supercharges your world-class workflow to unlock next-generation value with minimal friction.
' > zz-canary.md

sensors.name: prose-no-fact-loss
sensors.cmd: rg --files -g '*.md' | xargs -r prose-lint --before HEAD --no-max --json > /dev/null || rg --files -g '*.md' | xargs -r prose-lint --before HEAD --no-max
sensors.hint: The rewrite dropped a number, a backticked identifier or a URL that the committed revision had. Restore the specifics; tighten the prose around them instead.
sensors.canary:
f=$(rg --files -g '*.md' | head -1); printf '# Stub

All of the previous specifics are gone from this revision entirely.
' > "$f"
